title: more like a autograph book from when I was in grade ...
text: more like a autograph book from when I was in grade .... Thought there would be a little more to it, more like a autograph book from when I was in grade and high school.  Embossing could have been a little deeper.  For what I received I would have felt better paying 18.00 or a little less, but when you add in shipping and all it was fine.  Plus it is impossible to find locally anymore, 60th wedding anniversary stuff does not get sold much I am sure!

product_metadata.title: Hortense B. Hewitt Guest Book, 7.5 x 5.75-Inches, Diamond 60th Anniversary (10504)
features: Celebrate a Diamond Anniversary with this Guest Book featuring "60th anniversary" embossed in subtle pearl foil
Compact spiral bound book is 7. 5 inches x 5. 75 inches
First page has space to record the Event, Place, and Date
Lined signature pages have the words Guests printed at the top
description: Celebrate and remember a Diamond (60th) Anniversary with this guest book featuring embossed pearl foil design. Spiral bound book is a compact 7.5 x 5.75-inches and records up to 600 signatures. Ivory signing pages are printed with the word Guests at the top and ten lines. First page gives you a dedicated space to record the Event, Place, and Date. Spiral binding lets the book lay flat for easy signing. Guest book portion can be removed and the decorative book cover repurposed to create your own unique memento. Whether its a Silver, Golden, Ruby, or Diamond Anniversary, Hortense B. Hewitt helps you create a memorable occasion and create a keepsake to remember forever.
